<h1 id="journal-home-title">The R Journal</h1>
<p class="journal-hero-tagline">Peer-reviewed, open-access articles for R users and developers.</p>
<p>The R Journal is the official peer-reviewed publication of <a href="https://www.r-project.org/foundation/">the R Foundation</a>. Its articles highlight packages, programming, applications, reviews, benchmarks, teaching resources, and topics of interest to the broader R community. All articles are open access and there are no submission fees.</p>
